summary: Use an explicit bot User-Agent for anonymous Discord image downloads

replay.detail: No native projection or replay behavior changes.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol or replication compatibility changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or migration changes.

manual.detail: Restart an existing optional Discord bridge process to pick up the explicit DiscordBot image download User-Agent; preserve its delivery checkpoints and pending receipts. A bridge paused for an unrelated incident stays paused until that incident is cleared.
